notes: Silent English-captioned desktop simulation covering Milestones 3 (explicit sensor-bias reference) and 4 (frozen held-out evaluation + outlier scenario). Revised for an investor/reviewer audience: no em-dashes or double-hyphens in captions, and code-level identifiers (policy names, file paths, internal variable names) appear only as small secondary labels next to a plain-English description, never as the primary phrase. The robot's on-screen position is driven by simulator_true_distance/simulator_time from seed-10000 traces (unmodified); the belief halo (red/teal/violet) reports estimated_distance vs simulator_true_distance, which is where the bias/reference story actually lives. The outlier glitch times (7.19s, 8.07s) are the real 'unexpected_outcome' events in trace_outlier_ext1.json, not added for effect. Every aggregate number spoken in captions (success rates, the 54% move ratio, reconvergence decisions, bias estimate errors, the dev-vs-held-out replication figures) is read from results_ext1/{summary,reconvergence_summary,bias_reference_summary,outlier_summary}.csv and results_ext1_heldout/ via experiments/compare_heldout.py, not read off the single illustrative trial shown. No physical robot data or hardware validation is presented.
